name: fast-jev-compaction
description: Verbatim Jev-guided compaction for Claude Code sessions.

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: Key for Jev (TypeSafe), or for the decision endpoint when the decision cascade is used. Leave unset to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY, or DECISION_API_KEY for the decision endpoint.

keepThreshold.title: Keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: Minimum Jev probability that a tool call or tool result is still needed; below it the item is removed.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of newest messages pinned from compaction.

compactAtPercent.title: Compaction percentage
compactAtPercent.description: Context percentage at which turn.complete requests compaction.

wakeAtPercent.title: Wake-up percentage
wakeAtPercent.description: Context percentage at which cold decision models are sent a wake-up (at most every 5 minutes), so they are warm by compaction. They take 7-15 minutes to start.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Minimum estimated character reduction required to replace history.

maxStateTokens.title: Maximum Jev state tokens
maxStateTokens.description: Estimated token budget for the conversation state sent with every request. Default 25000 for Jev, 12000 for the decision cascade.

maxStateChars.title: Maximum state characters
maxStateChars.description: Character budget for the serialised state. Unlimited for Jev; 48000 for a decision-model cascade, so a model does not silently truncate it.

maxRequestTokens.title: Maximum Jev request tokens
maxRequestTokens.description: Estimated token budget for state plus questions in one request. Default 30000 for Jev, 14000 for the decision cascade.

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated tool result head
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters of a tool result kept when Jev decides its full output is no longer needed; 0 keeps only the note.

baseUrl.title: Decision endpoint URL
baseUrl.description: Base URL of a decision endpoint that serves each model at {baseUrl}/{model}. With models, replaces Jev. Leave unset to use DECISION_BASE_URL.

models.title: Decision models
models.description: Comma-separated models to try in order, best first; a cold model (HTTP 503) is skipped, never waited on. Leave unset to use DECISION_MODELS.

authHeader.title: Decision endpoint auth
authHeader.description: How the key is sent: 'x-api-key' (default) or 'bearer'.
